doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.section: FR-2.2: Dual-Embedding Strategy for Semantic Similarity
doc.snippet: System SHALL generate two embeddings per endpoint to enable domain object and full API similarity. Domain Object Embedding contains flattened request + response schemas. Full Endpoint Embedding contains path + method + headers + parameters + schemas.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.section: Novel Architectural Pattern: Dual-Embedding Semantic Discovery
doc.snippet: Generate two embeddings per endpoint: Domain Object Embedding (schemas only) and Full Endpoint Embedding (complete signature). Store raw OpenAPI schemas as Json, flattening deferred to Story 3.1.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Endpoint model includes apiVersionId, path, method, summary, description, operationId, tags[], requestSchema (Json), responseSchema (Json), parameters (Json), deprecated flag. Unique constraint on (apiVersionId, path, method).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Services follow pattern: embedding.service.ts, search.service.ts. Route structure uses FastifyPluginAsync. Fastify decorators for service injection. Use workspace protocol for internal packages.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Endpoint Extraction and Storage - Parse validated OpenAPI spec and create individual endpoint records. Extract path, method, request schema, response schema. Store each endpoint with metadata for future embedding generation.

constraints.constraint: MUST use dereferenced spec from OpenAPIValidationService (all $refs already resolved)
MUST use batch database operations for performance (createMany, deleteMany) - no N+1 queries
MUST follow Fastify plugin pattern with fp() wrapper and fastify.decorate()
MUST preserve existing webhook response structure, only populate endpoints_count with actual extracted count
MUST handle all HTTP methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS using HttpMethod enum
MUST NOT block webhook response for longer than 5 seconds for 100 endpoints
MUST store raw schemas as Json (not flattened strings) - flattening deferred to Story 3.1
MUST use Prisma ORM conventions: cuid() IDs, camelCase columns, cascade deletes
MUST follow structured logging pattern with Pino (request.log.info with context objects)
MUST follow error handling pattern: { error: { code, message, details } }
File naming: kebab-case for files (endpoint-extraction.service.ts), PascalCase for classes (EndpointExtractionService)
TypeScript module augmentation for Fastify instance decoration

interface.name: EndpointExtractionService
interface.signature: class EndpointExtractionService { constructor(prisma: PrismaClient) async extractAndStore(apiVersionId: string, dereferencedSpec: object): Promise<ExtractionResult> private extractEndpoints(spec: object): ExtractedEndpoint[] private buildEndpoint(path: string, method: string, operation: any): ExtractedEndpoint private extractRequestSchema(operation: any): object | null private extractResponseSchema(operation: any): object | null private extractParameters(operation: any): object | null private storeEndpoints(apiVersionId: string, endpoints: ExtractedEndpoint[]): Promise<void> }

interface.name: ExtractedEndpoint
interface.signature: interface ExtractedEndpoint { path: string method: string summary?: string description?: string operationId?: string tags: string[] requestSchema?: object responseSchema?: object parameters?: object deprecated: boolean }

interface.name: ExtractionResult
Fastify decorator

tests.standards: Testing uses Vitest framework with describe/it/expect pattern. Database integration tests are sequential (sequential: true) to avoid conflicts. Each test is self-contained with immediate cleanup using afterAll or finally blocks. Tests use unique names via randomUUID() to prevent collisions. Mock services via constructor injection for unit tests. Import db singleton from lib/db.ts for integration tests. Test fixtures should be placed in __tests__/fixtures/ directory.
